expectations.text: ThemeProvider with brand='ionos' wraps the output
Four stat card elements are present covering active servers, traffic, uptime, and tickets
expectations.evidence: statCards array has four entries: 'Active Servers', 'Monthly Traffic', 'Uptime', 'Open Tickets' (lines 55–83); all rendered as <Card> elements

expectations.text: CSS @keyframes or animation property is used for entrance animations
expectations.evidence: @keyframes fadeInUp and @keyframes fadeIn are defined in the animationStyles string (lines 13–49), injected via <style>{animationStyles}</style>

expectations.text: Each stat card has a different animation-delay value to create the stagger effect
expectations.evidence: animationDelay: `${200 + i * 120}ms` — each card (i=0..3) gets 200ms, 320ms, 440ms, 560ms respectively (line 246)

expectations.text: Colors reference CSS custom properties rather than hard-coded hex values
expectations.evidence: Most colors use var(--...) tokens, but statusStyles contains hard-coded hex values: '#0D9A5A', '#A06C00', '#C03228' for Running/Maintenance/Offline text colors (lines 127–138)

expectations.text: Server list section contains at least 3 rows/items
expectations.evidence: servers array has exactly 3 entries: 'web-prod-eu-01', 'db-prod-eu-02', 'cdn-edge-us-01' (lines 97–118), all rendered as rows

expectations.text: Animation durations are in the 200-600ms range (not instant or excessively long)
expectations.evidence: fadeInUp: 0.45s (450ms), fadeIn: 0.4s (400ms), fadeIn: 0.35s (350ms) — all within the 200–600ms range (lines 30–48)
